summary: Console search facets drop tracehook when exporting embedding usage CSV, orphaning alert links
description:
Issue summary:
Support ticket from NimbleChat: when they run a filtered Console 'Usage -> Embeddings' ad-hoc export (CSV) that includes console search facets, the exported rows strip or blank the tracehook parameter in the trace_url column. This causes exported alerts and downstream billing attribution scripts to show orphaned or 404 trace links.

Impact:
- Customer reports ~2.3k exported rows across several exports where tracehook param is missing.
- Alert drilldowns from exported reports return 404 or link to a different org context.
- Billing attribution jobs relying on exported route identifiers incorrectly mark ~1.1% of embedding units as "unattributed" leading to a billing discrepancy ticket.

Environment:
- Customer: NimbleChat (dedicated capacity)
- Console region: us-east
- Model: text-embedding-3-large

Steps to reproduce:
1) Login as org admin for NimbleChat in prod (us-east).
2) Navigate to Console -> Usage -> Embeddings.
3) Apply custom search facet: route:"/api/generate" AND tag:campaign_2026
4) Click Export -> CSV (full export, include trace_url column).
5) Inspect exported CSV: trace_url column values for many rows end with "?tracehook=" or are empty instead of containing the expected token.

Observed behavior:
- trace_url values end in an empty tracehook param, e.g., "https://console.redwood/trace/abc123?tracehook=", or are completely empty.
- The Console UI shows valid trace links for the same rows (tracehook present) prior to export.

Expected behavior:
- Exported CSV preserves tracehook tokens exactly as shown in Console UI so links are valid and attribution scripts can use them.

Attachments / Logs:
- Customer-provided sample CSV (attached to ticket), 3 export timestamps: 2026-03-09T18:12Z, 2026-03-09T18:45Z, 2026-03-09T19:05Z.
- Console request IDs from customer: req_us_east_98321, req_us_east_98355.
- Customer screencast showing UI vs exported file (shared via secure link).

Temporary workaround offered:
- Support suggested customer use the Console UI drilldown and copy trace link directly (tedious) or call internal API /v1/usage/export with include_tracehook=true (undocumented flag) as interim until fix.

Notes:
- First response delivered 2026-03-10 by Priya Shah (acknowledged, requested logs and sample exports).
comments: 2026-03-10 15:12 UTC - Priya Shah (Support): Ack'd ticket. Asked for sample CSVs and console request IDs. Recommended using UI drilldown as short-term workaround.
2026-03-10 16:30 UTC - Customer (NimbleChat): Uploaded sample_csv_v1.csv and screencap. Says issue reproducible across 3 org owners.

2026-03-11 09:00 UTC - Ethan Walker (Eng): Reproduced locally in staging with a synthetic export. Tracehook token present in UI retrieval call but blanked during CSV serialization path. Added initial hypothesis that CSV sanitizer strips URL query when exporting nested facet values.

2026-03-11 12:45 UTC - SRE OnCall (Liam Chen): Checked prod export worker logs for req_us_east_98321. Found export pipeline step 'normalize_facets' called url_unescape() which treats '=' characters in tracehook payload as delimiter and drops value when length > 256. Correlation with large tracehook tokens (>300 chars) matches customer samples.

2026-03-12 02:10 UTC - Ethan Walker (Eng): Created repro PR to add length-preserving serializer and a flag to preserve raw querystring. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/11234. Marked as security-sensitive because export touches tracehooks.
2026-03-12 18:30 UTC - Support (Priya Shah): Notified NimbleChat of progress and that a staged fix is being prepared for rollout to prod with feature flag.
2026-03-13 08:55 UTC - SRE (Liam Chen): Observed no regressions in export worker performance with serializer change in canary; tracehook tokens now appear intact in canary exports.

2026-03-13 12:30 UTC - Ethan Walker (Eng): Scheduled patch deployment to prod rolling update with feature flag enable window 2026-03-14 02:00-03:00 UTC. Recommended that Support coordinate with customer for verification after deploy.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: facet normalization step strips or truncates querystring values containing '=' and long tokens, due to legacy CSV sanitizer that attempts to 'clean' parameters for CSV safety.
Reproduction: ran export job in staging with tracehook tokens of varying length; tokens > 256 chars were dropped consistently during normalize_facets step.
Logs: export-worker-42 shows stack frame at export.serialize_facets -> normalize_facets -> url_unescape where token discarded.

Security review: tracehook is not PII but tokens are sensitive; change must preserve tokens in exports while preventing accidental leakage to public exports. Added guard to only enable raw querystring preservation for org-scoped exports (not public share links).
Canary: serializer change tested on 3 canary orgs for 12 hours, no I/O or CPU spike observed.
root_cause: Legacy CSV facet normalization logic used a url_unescape sanitizer that treated long querystring values and '=' characters as separators and truncated/blanked the tracehook value when exceeding a 256-char internal threshold.
resolution_notes: Patch applied to export-worker serializer to preserve raw querystring for org-scoped exports and removed hard 256-char truncate. Deployed to canary 2026-03-12, rolled to prod 2026-03-14 in a feature-flagged rollout. Post-deploy verification confirmed tracehook values present in exported CSVs for NimbleChat. Billing attribution recalculation recommended.
mitigation: Enabled feature-flagged serializer in canary then prod. Provided customer a one-off re-export route via internal export API to regenerate CSVs with preserved tracehooks. Finance notified to recalculate the small billing discrepancy and credit if necessary.
follow_up_tasks: ENG-1248: Add unit tests covering CSV export with long querystring tokens
SEC-342: Review export sharing UX to avoid exposing tracehooks in public exports
OPS-212: Add monitoring metric for blank tracehook occurrence rate in exports
slo_impact_summary: No platform-wide SLO impact. Affects tracehook preservation for CSV exports only. Customer-facing impact: broken drilldown links and small billing misattribution for one enterprise org.
customer_notes: Customer validated post-deploy export and confirmed trace links intact in re-exported CSV. Requested follow-up to confirm billing recalculation. Asked for permanent fix timeline; provided ETA: 2026-03-14 release and post-release verification window.
estimated_customer_impact_units: ~1.1% of embedding units for NimbleChat in the affected export window (~2.3k rows)
